description:
checksum integrity job doesn't actually resume from checkpoint (processes 0 files, claims covered all assets)

**What happened**

Ran the new integrity checks on my library (~33k assets / 750GB). The checksum job hit the 1 hour time limit at about 66% and logged `Finished checksum job, will continue from 2026-06-18T18:35:26.293Z.` which is expected.

But when the job runs again it finishes instantly:

```
Checking file checksums... (will run for up to 3.00 hours or until 100.00% of assets are processed)
Processing assets in range [2026-06-18T18:35:26.293Z, end]
Processing assets in range [beginning, 2026-06-18T18:35:26.293Z]
Processed 0 files so far... (avg. Infinity ms/asset, 0.00% of all assets)
Finished checksum job, covered all assets.
```

0 files processed but it claims everything is covered. So the last third of my library never actually gets checksummed and there's no error or anything, it…
evidence: test: integrity.service.spec.ts: should continue from checkpoint

notes: Issue with job log; checkpoint resume processes 0 files. Fix: streamAssetChecksums filters/orders by asset.createdAt (was integrity_report.createdAt) and handleChecksumFiles drops the endMarker loop; RC exact. Log lines are symptom evidence (policy 2). Boundary job: checksum integrity job (OnJob IntegrityChecksumFiles, integrity.service.ts:533).
